verdict.rationale: The evidence covers case management, alert grouping, filings, exports and configurable workflows, but nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from user data inside the product. The marketing lines about agents, routine automation and dispositioning alerts 'more intelligently' are too vague to count as a documented insight or suggestion feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
